task: Upgrade Falco from 0.39.2 (chart 4.16.0, disabled since 2026-07-08) to 0.45.1 (chart 9.2.1) and enable it on every provider (owner decision 2026-10-28). Scope of this change: repository chart values, image/chart/inventory/SBOM pins, the portal Loki reader seam, docs and regression updates. The orchestrator does the live chart publish, image mirroring and GitOps push after merge. Falco on the Ubuntu 26.04 / kernel 7.0 Vagrant box is NOT verified.

events.summary: Rewrite the falco Application for chart 9.2.1 / Falco 0.45.1 and remove its if-false guard; keep modern_ebpf, resources and the privileged DaemonSet; make it airgap-safe (falcoctl install and follow off, the container plugin and falco-rules come from the image); bump images.txt, image-digests.tsv, component-licenses.tsv, chart-upstream-sources.tsv, the SBOM review map, VERSIONS.md, the compatibility matrix, both gitops READMEs, NOTICE and CHANGELOGs; drop the Ubuntu 26.04 falco exclusion from 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh; fix the portal Loki reader; add R291 (check-falco.py --mutation-verify). Deliberately left alone: portal security page 26.04 gating, i18n and kisa-controls text that still say Falco is unavailable, 01-generate-image-list.sh, Kyverno and PSA (no change needed). No cluster, ssh, vagrant, helm install or push was used.

Falco 0.39.2 modern_ebpf fails scap_init on a kernel 7.0.14 VM and 0.45.1 does not. Reproduced 2026-10-27 on a local Docker Desktop VM (Linux 7.0.14-linuxkit aarch64, BTF present): docker.io/falcosecurity/falco-no-driver:0.39.2 run privileged with -o engine.kind=modern_ebpf exits 1 with 'An error occurred in an event source, forcing termination... Error: Initialization issues during scap_init', the same signature as the 2026-07-08 Vagrant failure; docker.io/falcosecurity/falco:0.45.1 on the same VM opens the modern BPF probe. Upstream attributes the 7.0 breakage to libs fixes absent from 0.39.2 (libs 0.18.2) and present in 0.45.1 (libs 0.26.1): #2997 execve verifier count, #3021 sendmmsg bpf_loop, #3086 auxmap race on preemptible kernels (reporters on Ubuntu 26.04 kernels 7.0.0-27 and 7.0.0-28, and on 7.0.0-31, confirm 0.45.0-rc1), #3119 signal_deliver verifier. Seam defects found while reading the portal reader against real output: falcosidekick's Loki priority label is Capitalized (portal selected lowercase), Loki lines are JSON only with loki.format=json (default text is dropped by the portal), source=falco exists only on Alertmanager alerts, metrics.outputRule emits an hourly snapshot event into the portal feed, and the removed collectors.containerd key is silently ignored by chart 9.x.

events.summary: falco.yaml now targets chart 9.2.1 with explicit image pins (falco 0.45.1, falcosidekick 2.32.0, both docker.io because ghcr.io and quay.io do not host them), modern_ebpf, falcoctl off, collectors.containerEngine with only the CRI engine on /run/containerd/containerd.sock, loki.format json, metrics.outputRule false, and release=prometheus-stack on both ServiceMonitors (Prometheus only selects labelled monitors). The old falco.grpc, falco.grpc_output, collectors.containerd and k8s_audit_rules.yaml entries and the inert loki.tenantmap and alertmanager.expirealert keys are gone. Airgap inventories, SBOM review map, VERSIONS.md and the compatibility matrix carry the same pins; 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh no longer removes falco on Ubuntu 26.04; NOTICE no longer calls Falco an unlisted component.

Portal reader seam: portal/src/lib/falco.ts now matches the priority label with an alternation of the Capitalized and lowercase spellings (the lowercase equality matched no falcosidekick stream) and normalises Falco's JSON null fields; falco.test.ts pins the contract with a verbatim Falco 0.45.1 -> falcosidekick 2.32.0 -> Loki capture. R291 (check-falco.py) holds the remaining silent failure modes with 45 mutations, each required to be caught by its own assertion id.
